name: notary-watch
description: Follows Apple notarization submissions made with xcrun notarytool submit, directly or from a release script: status line while in progress, toast when accepted or invalid

scriptPattern.title: Release script pattern
scriptPattern.description: A main-agent Bash command that runs a script whose file name contains this text (e.g. Scripts/release.sh) is followed through notarytool history; empty turns it off

keychainProfile.title: Keychain profile
keychainProfile.description: The notarytool keychain profile to query history with; empty reads it from the script
